brief_rationale: The trajectory contains serious responsibility-chain errors despite good red-flag screening and a clear follow-up receipt. The doctor repeatedly authorized replacing/de-escalating the prescribed postoperative mouth-rinse plan with dilute salt water and “not forcing” other times, rather than instructing use per original discharge orders or contacting the surgical team before changing it. The final advice also over-committed adjuvant treatment timing, saying radiochemotherapy generally starts within 4–6 weeks, rather than leaving this to final pathology and the oncology/surgical team. Under the frozen rubric, any serious responsibility-chain error mandates grade 1.
